messages:
Maya P: Heads up — CI red on my PR (#4823). mypy errors popped after I bumped typing-extensions to 4.9.1. Any quick triage tips?

CI Bot: build/4823 — FAILED
- job: unit-tests
- task: mypy

CI Bot: mypy output (excerpt):
```
src/redwood/serving/runtime.py:412: error: "KVCache" has no attribute 'prefetch'
src/redwood/serving/runtime.py:421: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Any", variable has type "Dict[str, Tensor]")
Found 2 errors in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```

Sam W: hmm, that first error looks like a typing-extensions API change? did you change any stubs?

Maya P: nope, only bumped typing-extensions in pyproject, no code changes. local `mypy` passes for me though :/

Juan R: can you paste the exact `pip freeze` or `poetry show` output? maybe CI installs a different resolver.

Maya P: here's the env from CI job:
```
typing-extensions==4.9.1
mypy==1.3.0
python==3.10.12
```

Kevin L: try `tox -e mypy` in a clean venv like CI. Also check `MYPYPATH`/stubs. pre-commit might pin older stubs.

Maya P: kicking a rerun now (re-run in CI). will paste results.

CI Bot: re-run queued by @maya

CI Bot: build/4823 — RUNNING

CI Bot: build/4823 — FAILED (rerun)

CI Bot: mypy output (rerun excerpt):
```
src/redwood/serving/runtime.py:412: error: "KVCache" has no attribute 'prefetch'  [attr-defined]
src/redwood/serving/runtime.py:421: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Any", variable has type "Dict[str, Tensor]")  [assignment]
Found 2 errors in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```

Sam W: would you be ok if I try a quick `git bisect` between before/after the bump? could be a change in our stubs or in mypy's behavior.

Maya P: yes plz, thx

Sam W: need the commit SHAs for the bump PR and the previous main head

Maya P: bump commit: `a9c3d7f` (PR merge), previous main: `7f2b1aa`

Sam W: starting bisect locally, will report back. :coffee:

Sam W: bisect found the first bad commit: `3f6ad4b` — it's a small change to internal stubs in `types/serving.pyi` where `KVCache` lost `prefetch` in the stub. looks like when we reorganized stubs in #4601 the method was accidentally removed.

Sam W: quick fix in stubs would unblock CI. I'll open a tiny PR to restore that signature and add a test to cover the stub.

Maya P: amazing, thanks! I can hold this PR until that lands. :relieved:

Juan R: fyi we should also add a mypy regression test to the CI matrix to catch stub drift.

Kevin L: agree. filing a follow-up to add a `mypy-regressions` job that runs on typing-related PRs.

Maya P: plan: revert bump? or wait for stub PR? prefer waiting if it's fast

Sam W: PR up in 5m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4898 :eyes:

CI Bot: build/4898 — PENDING

CI Bot: build/4898 — PASSED

Maya P: re-running PR build now

CI Bot: build/4823 — RUNNING

CI Bot: build/4823 — PASSED

Maya P: ✅ thanks all, will merge once green. Kudos to @Sam W for bisecting so quick :tada:

Kevin L: nice. leaving a note in the release checklist about verifying stub integrity when reorganizing types.

Sam W: np. if anyone hits this again ping me.

Maya P: closing loop — merged and released. :shipit:
